class Entry(int key, string value)
    string display()
        return "{key}={value}"

class Node(Entry[] entries := [], int[] children := [])
    string notation()
        return "[" + [for item := entries[] then string(item.key)].join(" ") + "]"

    int position(int sought)
        for index := entries.indices()[]
            if sought <= entries[index].key
                return int(index)
        return int(#entries)

    bool leaf()
        return #children == 0

class Tree(int degree)
    root := 0
    pages := map<int, Node>()
    splits := 0
    merges := 0
    borrows := 0
    .pages.set(0, Node())

class Search(int page, int position, bool found, string[] path)
class Changes(int writes, int frees)
class Scan(Entry[] entries, int visited)
class Trace(bool enabled)
    string[] lines := []
    string[] cases := []

T[] inserted<T>(const T[] source, int index, T item)
    return source[0:<index].append(item).concat(source[index:])

T[] erased<T>(const T[] source, int index)
    return source[0:<index].concat(source[index + 1:])

Node | error get_node(const Tree source, int page)
    match source.pages.get(page)
        Node item
            return item
        none
            return error("missing internal page")

int key_count(const Tree source, int page)
    item := get_node(source, page)
    return int(#item.entries)

int allocate(Tree &index, Node item)
    page := 0
    while index.pages.has(page)
        page += 1
    .index.pages.set(page, item)
    return page

Entry[] tree_entries(const Tree source, int page)
    item := get_node(source, page)
    Entry[] result := []
    for: 0 <= position <= int(#item.entries)
        if not item.leaf()
            result = result.concat(tree_entries(source, item.children[position]))
        if position < int(#item.entries)
            result = result.append(item.entries[position])
    return result

Search search(const Tree source, int key)
    page := source.root
    string[] path := []
    while true
        item := get_node(source, page)
        path = path.append(item.notation())
        position := item.position(key)
        if position < int(#item.entries) and item.entries[position].key == key
            return Search(page, position, true, path)
        if item.leaf()
            return Search(page, position, false, path)
        page = item.children[position]

string bound_text(int | none value, string absent)
    match value
        int bound
            return string(bound)
        none
            return absent

bool outside_bound(int key, int | none bound, bool lower)
    match bound
        int value
            return if lower then key <= value else key >= value
        none
            return false

string | none check_node(const Tree source, int page, string location, int depth, int | none low, int | none high, int &reference)
    item := get_node(source, page)
    count := int(#item.entries)
    minimum := if page == source.root then (if item.leaf() then 0 else 1) else source.degree - 1
    maximum := 2 * source.degree - 1
    details := "at={location} node=" + item.notation()
    if not (minimum <= count <= maximum)
        return "COUNT {details} keys={count} allowed={minimum}..{maximum}"
    for: position < count - 1
        if item.entries[position].key >= item.entries[position + 1].key
            return "ORDER {details} {item.entries[position].key}>={item.entries[position + 1].key}"
    for entry := item.entries[]
        if outside_bound(entry.key, low, true) or outside_bound(entry.key, high, false)
            return "RANGE {details} key={entry.key} low=" + bound_text(low, "-inf") + " high=" + bound_text(high, "+inf")
    if item.leaf()
        if reference == -1
            reference = depth
        elif depth != reference
            return "DEPTH {details} depth={depth} expected={reference}"
    for position := item.children.indices()[]
        int | none lower := low
        int | none upper := high
        if position > 0
            lower = item.entries[position - 1].key
        if position < #item.entries
            upper = item.entries[position].key
        match check_node(source, item.children[position], "{location}.{position}", depth + 1, lower, upper, &reference)
            string problem
                return problem
            none
                continue
    return none

string | none violation(const Tree source)
    reference := -1
    return check_node(source, source.root, "root", 0, none, none, &reference)

string status(const Tree source)
    match violation(source)
        string
            return "DAMAGED"
        none
            return "OK"

string summary(const Tree source)
    return "nodes={source.pages.size()} keys={#tree_entries(source, source.root)} " + status(source)

int height(const Tree source)
    depth := 0
    item := get_node(source, source.root)
    while not item.leaf()
        item = get_node(source, item.children[0])
        depth += 1
    return depth

class Parser(Tree index, string[] tokens)
    position := 0

string peek(const Parser parser)
    return if parser.position == int(#parser.tokens) then "" else parser.tokens[parser.position]

Entry | error parse_entry(Parser &parser)
    token := peek(parser)
    match token.find("=")
        nat position
            parser.position += 1
            return Entry(int(token[0:<position]), token[position + 1:])
        none
            return error("SYNTAX {parser.position + 1}")

int | error parse_node(Parser &parser)
    if peek(parser) != "("
        return error("SYNTAX {parser.position + 1}")
    parser.position += 1
    page := allocate(&parser.index, Node())
    item := Node()
    internal := peek(parser) == "("
    if internal
        child := try parse_node(&parser)
        item.children = item.children.append(child)
    while peek(parser) != ")"
        entry := try parse_entry(&parser)
        item.entries = item.entries.append(entry)
        if internal
            child := try parse_node(&parser)
            item.children = item.children.append(child)
    parser.position += 1
    .parser.index.pages.set(page, item)
    return page

Tree | error load_tree(int degree, const string[] tokens)
    parser := Parser(Tree(degree), tokens)
    .parser.index.pages.remove(0)
    parser.index.root = try parse_node(&parser)
    if parser.position != int(#tokens)
        return error("SYNTAX {parser.position + 1}")
    return parser.index

Changes changes(const Tree source, const map<int, Node> before)
    writes := 0
    for page := source.pages.keys()[]
        current := get_node(source, page)
        match before.get(page)
            Node previous
                if current != previous
                    writes += 1
            none
                writes += 1
    frees := int(#[for page := before.keys()[] if not source.pages.has(page) then page])
    return Changes(writes, frees)

void emit_step(Trace &log, string line)
    if log.enabled
        log.lines = log.lines.append("STEP " + line)

void split_child(Tree &index, int parent_page, int position, Trace &log)
    parent := get_node(index, parent_page)
    child_page := parent.children[position]
    child := get_node(index, child_page)
    original := child.notation()
    middle := child.entries[index.degree - 1]
    int[] right_children := if child.leaf() then [] else child.children[index.degree:]
    right_page := allocate(&index, Node(child.entries[index.degree:], right_children))
    child.entries = child.entries[0:<index.degree - 1]
    if not child.leaf()
        child.children = child.children[0:<index.degree]
    parent.entries = inserted(parent.entries, position, middle)
    parent.children = inserted(parent.children, position + 1, right_page)
    .index.pages.set(child_page, child)
    .index.pages.set(parent_page, parent)
    index.splits += 1
    emit_step(&log, "split page={child_page} keys={original} up={middle.key} new={right_page}")

string | none upsert(Tree &index, Entry entry, Trace &log)
    found := search(index, entry.key)
    if found.found
        item := get_node(index, found.page)
        previous := item.entries[found.position].value
        item.entries[found.position] = entry
        .index.pages.set(found.page, item)
        return previous
    if key_count(index, index.root) == 2 * index.degree - 1
        index.root = allocate(&index, Node([], [index.root]))
        emit_step(&log, "grow page={index.root}")
        split_child(&index, index.root, 0, &log)
    page := index.root
    current := get_node(index, page)
    while not current.leaf()
        position := current.position(entry.key)
        if key_count(index, current.children[position]) == 2 * index.degree - 1
            split_child(&index, page, position, &log)
            current = get_node(index, page)
            if entry.key > current.entries[position].key
                position += 1
        page = current.children[position]
        current = get_node(index, page)
    current.entries = inserted(current.entries, current.position(entry.key), entry)
    .index.pages.set(page, current)
    emit_step(&log, "place page={page} keys=" + current.notation())
    return none

Entry extreme(const Tree source, int page, bool last)
    item := get_node(source, page)
    while not item.leaf()
        child := if last then item.children[-1] else item.children[0]
        item = get_node(source, child)
    return if last then item.entries[-1] else item.entries[0]

int merge_child(Tree &index, int parent_page, int position, string case_name, Trace &log)
    parent := get_node(index, parent_page)
    left_page := parent.children[position]
    right_page := parent.children[position + 1]
    left := get_node(index, left_page)
    right := get_node(index, right_page)
    left.entries = left.entries.append(parent.entries[position]).concat(right.entries)
    left.children = left.children.concat(right.children)
    parent.entries = erased(parent.entries, position)
    parent.children = erased(parent.children, position + 1)
    .index.pages.set(left_page, left)
    .index.pages.set(parent_page, parent)
    .index.pages.remove(right_page)
    index.merges += 1
    emit_step(&log, "{case_name} page={parent_page} merge={left_page}+{right_page} keys=" + left.notation())
    if parent_page == index.root and #parent.entries == 0
        index.root = left_page
        .index.pages.remove(parent_page)
        emit_step(&log, "shrink page={left_page}")
    return left_page

void delete_at(Tree &index, int page, int key, Trace &log)
    item := get_node(index, page)
    position := item.position(key)
    if position < int(#item.entries) and item.entries[position].key == key
        if item.leaf()
            log.cases = log.cases.append("1")
            item.entries = erased(item.entries, position)
            .index.pages.set(page, item)
            emit_step(&log, "1 page={page} keys=" + item.notation())
            return
        left := item.children[position]
        right := item.children[position + 1]
        if key_count(index, left) >= index.degree
            predecessor := extreme(index, left, true)
            log.cases = log.cases.append("2a")
            emit_step(&log, "2a page={page} pred={predecessor.key}")
            delete_at(&index, left, predecessor.key, &log)
            item.entries[position] = predecessor
            .index.pages.set(page, item)
        elif key_count(index, right) >= index.degree
            successor := extreme(index, right, false)
            log.cases = log.cases.append("2b")
            emit_step(&log, "2b page={page} succ={successor.key}")
            delete_at(&index, right, successor.key, &log)
            item.entries[position] = successor
            .index.pages.set(page, item)
        else
            log.cases = log.cases.append("2c")
            child_page := merge_child(&index, page, position, "2c", &log)
            delete_at(&index, child_page, key, &log)
        return
    child_page := item.children[position]
    child := get_node(index, child_page)
    if int(#child.entries) == index.degree - 1
        left := if position > 0 then item.children[position - 1] else -1
        right := if position < int(#item.entries) then item.children[position + 1] else -1
        if left != -1 and key_count(index, left) >= index.degree
            sibling := get_node(index, left)
            log.cases = log.cases.append("3a-left")
            child.entries = inserted(child.entries, 0, item.entries[position - 1])
            item.entries[position - 1] = sibling.entries[-1]
            sibling.entries = sibling.entries[0:<int(#sibling.entries) - 1]
            if not sibling.leaf()
                child.children = inserted(child.children, 0, sibling.children[-1])
                sibling.children = sibling.children[0:<int(#sibling.children) - 1]
            .index.pages.set(left, sibling)
            .index.pages.set(child_page, child)
            .index.pages.set(page, item)
            index.borrows += 1
            emit_step(&log, "3a-left page={page} child={child_page} from={left} keys=" + child.notation())
        elif right != -1 and key_count(index, right) >= index.degree
            sibling := get_node(index, right)
            log.cases = log.cases.append("3a-right")
            child.entries = child.entries.append(item.entries[position])
            item.entries[position] = sibling.entries[0]
            sibling.entries = sibling.entries[1:]
            if not sibling.leaf()
                child.children = child.children.append(sibling.children[0])
                sibling.children = sibling.children[1:]
            .index.pages.set(right, sibling)
            .index.pages.set(child_page, child)
            .index.pages.set(page, item)
            index.borrows += 1
            emit_step(&log, "3a-right page={page} child={child_page} from={right} keys=" + child.notation())
        elif left != -1
            log.cases = log.cases.append("3b-left")
            child_page = merge_child(&index, page, position - 1, "3b-left", &log)
        else
            log.cases = log.cases.append("3b-right")
            child_page = merge_child(&index, page, position, "3b-right", &log)
    delete_at(&index, child_page, key, &log)

Scan scan_range(const Tree source, int page, int low, int high)
    item := get_node(source, page)
    Entry[] result := []
    visits := 1
    count := int(#item.entries)
    for: 0 <= position <= count
        if not item.leaf() and (position == 0 or item.entries[position - 1].key < high) and (position == count or item.entries[position].key > low)
            child := scan_range(source, item.children[position], low, high)
            result = result.concat(child.entries)
            visits += child.visited
        if position < count and low <= item.entries[position].key <= high
            result = result.append(item.entries[position])
    return Scan(result, visits)

string[] dump_node(const Tree source, int page)
    item := get_node(source, page)
    tokens := ["("]
    for: 0 <= position <= int(#item.entries)
        if not item.leaf()
            tokens = tokens.concat(dump_node(source, item.children[position]))
        if position < int(#item.entries)
            tokens = tokens.append(item.entries[position].display())
    return tokens.append(")")

int copy_group(Tree &index, const Node[] built, int old_page)
    source := built[old_page]
    item := Node(source.entries)
    page := allocate(&index, Node())
    for old_child := source.children[]
        item.children = item.children.append(copy_group(&index, built, old_child))
    .index.pages.set(page, item)
    return page

Tree compact_tree(const Tree source)
    entries := tree_entries(source, source.root)
    int[] children := []
    Node[] built := []
    root := 0
    while true
        groups := (int(#entries) + 2 * source.degree) / (2 * source.degree)
        keys := int(#entries) - (groups - 1)
        base := keys / groups
        extra := keys % groups
        position := 0
        child_position := 0
        Entry[] separators := []
        int[] level := []
        for: group < groups
            count := base + (if group < extra then 1 else 0)
            int[] item_children := if #children == 0 then [] else children[child_position:<child_position + count + 1]
            item := Node(entries[position:<position + count], item_children)
            level = level.append(int(#built))
            built = built.append(item)
            position += count
            child_position += count + 1
            if group + 1 < groups
                separators = separators.append(entries[position])
                position += 1
        if groups == 1
            root = level[0]
            break
        entries = separators
        children = level
    result := Tree(source.degree)
    .result.pages.remove(0)
    result.root = copy_group(&result, built, root)
    return result

enum CursorKind
    Unset
    Key
    Begin
    End

class Cursor(CursorKind kind := CursorKind.Unset, key := 0)
class Workbench()
    Tree | none index := none
    Tree | none saved := none
    cursor := Cursor()
    trace := false

bool needs_valid(string command)
    commands := ["INSERT", "BULKLOAD", "DELETE", "DELRANGE", "RANGE", "COUNT", "MIN", "MAX", "FLOOR", "CEIL", "RANK", "SELECT", "SEEK", "NEXT", "PREV", "HEIGHT", "COMPACT"]
    for name := commands[]
        if command == name
            return true
    return false

string[] | error execute(Workbench &workbench, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    command := words[0]
    if command == "TRACE"
        workbench.trace = words[1] == "ON"
        return ["TRACE {words[1]}"]
    int first := if #words > 1 then int(words[1]) else 0
    ranged := command == "DELRANGE" or command == "RANGE" or command == "COUNT"
    int second := if ranged then int(words[2]) else 0
    if command == "CREATE" or command == "LOAD"
        if not (2 <= first <= 5)
            return error("BAD DEGREE {first}")
        replacement := Tree(first)
        result := "CREATE t={first}"
        if command == "LOAD"
            replacement = try load_tree(first, words[2:])
            result = "LOAD t={first} " + summary(replacement)
        workbench.index = replacement
        workbench.cursor = Cursor()
        return [result]
    Tree index
    match workbench.index
        Tree current
            index = current
        none
            return error("NO INDEX")
    if needs_valid(command) and status(index) == "DAMAGED"
        return error("DAMAGED")
    entries := tree_entries(index, index.root)
    if ranged and first > second
        return error("BAD RANGE {first} {second}")
    if command == "SELECT" and not (1 <= first <= int(#entries))
        return error("BAD POSITION {first}")
    if (command == "NEXT" or command == "PREV") and workbench.cursor.kind == CursorKind.Unset
        return error("NO CURSOR")
    if command == "RESTORE"
        match workbench.saved
            Tree stored
                workbench.index = stored
                return ["RESTORE " + summary(stored)]
            none
                return error("NO SAVE")
    string[] output := []
    log := Trace(workbench.trace and (command == "INSERT" or command == "DELETE"))
    if command == "INSERT"
        before := index.pages
        splits := index.splits
        string | none old := upsert(&index, Entry(first, words[2]), &log)
        writes := changes(index, before).writes
        output = log.lines
        match old
            string previous
                output = output.append("INSERT {first} UPDATED old={previous} writes={writes}")
            none
                output = output.append("INSERT {first} NEW splits={index.splits - splits} height={height(index)} writes={writes}")
    elif command == "BULKLOAD"
        before := index.pages
        splits := index.splits
        updated := 0
        for: 1 <= position < int(#words) step 2
            match upsert(&index, Entry(int(words[position]), words[position + 1]), &log)
                string
                    updated += 1
                none
                    continue
        pairs := (int(#words) - 1) / 2
        output = ["BULKLOAD pairs={pairs} new={pairs - updated} updated={updated} splits={index.splits - splits} height={height(index)} writes={changes(index, before).writes}"]
    elif command == "DELETE"
        found := search(index, first)
        if not found.found
            output = ["DELETE {first} NOT FOUND"]
        else
            item := get_node(index, found.page)
            previous := item.entries[found.position].value
            before := index.pages
            delete_at(&index, index.root, first, &log)
            delta := changes(index, before)
            output = log.lines.append("DELETE {first} REMOVED value={previous} cases=" + log.cases.join(",") + " height={height(index)} writes={delta.writes} frees={delta.frees}")
    elif command == "DELRANGE"
        before := index.pages
        merges := index.merges
        borrows := index.borrows
        selected := [for item := entries[] if first <= item.key <= second then item.key]
        for key := selected[]
            log.cases = []
            delete_at(&index, index.root, key, &log)
        delta := changes(index, before)
        output = ["DELRANGE {first} {second} removed={#selected} merges={index.merges - merges} borrows={index.borrows - borrows} height={height(index)} writes={delta.writes} frees={delta.frees}"]
    elif command == "GET"
        found := search(index, first)
        result := "NOT FOUND"
        if found.found
            item := get_node(index, found.page)
            result = "FOUND value={item.entries[found.position].value}"
        output = ["GET {first} {result} path=" + found.path.join(" -> ")]
    elif command == "RANGE" or command == "COUNT"
        result := scan_range(index, index.root, first, second)
        row := "{command} {first} {second} count={#result.entries} visited={result.visited}"
        if command == "RANGE"
            for item := result.entries[]
                row += " " + item.display()
        output = [row]
    elif command == "MIN" or command == "MAX"
        result := "EMPTY"
        if #entries != 0
            position := if command == "MIN" then 0 else int(#entries) - 1
            result = entries[position].display()
        output = ["{command} {result}"]
    elif command == "FLOOR" or command == "CEIL" or command == "SEEK"
        eligible := [for item := entries[] if (if command == "FLOOR" then item.key <= first else item.key >= first) then item]
        result := "NONE"
        if command == "SEEK"
            workbench.cursor = Cursor(CursorKind.End)
            result = "END"
        if #eligible != 0
            position := if command == "FLOOR" then int(#eligible) - 1 else 0
            selected := eligible[position]
            result = selected.display()
            if command == "SEEK"
                workbench.cursor = Cursor(CursorKind.Key, selected.key)
        output = ["{command} {first} {result}"]
    elif command == "RANK"
        count := int(#[for item := entries[] if item.key < first then item])
        output = ["RANK {first} {count}"]
    elif command == "SELECT"
        output = ["SELECT {first} " + entries[first - 1].display()]
    elif command == "NEXT" or command == "PREV"
        forward := command == "NEXT"
        Entry[] eligible := []
        if workbench.cursor.kind == CursorKind.Key
            eligible = [for item := entries[] if (if forward then item.key > workbench.cursor.key else item.key < workbench.cursor.key) then item]
        elif (forward and workbench.cursor.kind == CursorKind.Begin) or (not forward and workbench.cursor.kind == CursorKind.End)
            eligible = entries
        workbench.cursor = Cursor(if forward then CursorKind.End else CursorKind.Begin)
        result := if forward then "END" else "BEGIN"
        if #eligible != 0
            selected := eligible[if forward then 0 else int(#eligible) - 1]
            workbench.cursor = Cursor(CursorKind.Key, selected.key)
            result = selected.display()
        output = ["{command} {result}"]
    elif command == "PRINT"
        level := [index.root]
        depth := 0
        while #level != 0
            row := "LEVEL {depth}"
            int[] following := []
            for page := level[]
                item := get_node(index, page)
                row += " " + item.notation()
                following = following.concat(item.children)
            output = output.append(row)
            level = following
            depth += 1
    elif command == "PAGES"
        for page := index.pages.keys().sorted()[]
            item := get_node(index, page)
            kids := if item.leaf() then "-" else [for child := item.children[] then string(child)].join(",")
            output = output.append("PAGE {page} " + item.notation() + " kids={kids}")
    elif command == "DUMP"
        output = ["DUMP {index.degree} " + dump_node(index, index.root).join(" ")]
    elif command == "HEIGHT"
        output = ["HEIGHT {height(index)}"]
    elif command == "STATS"
        nodes := int(index.pages.size())
        leaf_counts := [for item := index.pages.values()[] then (if item.leaf() then 1 else 0)]
        leaves := leaf_counts.sum()
        fill := 100 * int(#entries) / ((2 * index.degree - 1) * nodes)
        output = ["STATS t={index.degree} nodes={nodes} leaves={leaves} keys={#entries} fill={fill}% splits={index.splits} merges={index.merges} borrows={index.borrows}"]
    elif command == "VERIFY"
        match violation(index)
            string problem
                output = ["VERIFY FAIL {problem}"]
            none
                output = ["VERIFY OK"]
    elif command == "REBUILD"
        index = Tree(index.degree)
        for item := entries[]
            upsert(&index, item, &log)
        output = ["REBUILD entries={#entries} keys={#tree_entries(index, index.root)} nodes={index.pages.size()} splits={index.splits} height={height(index)}"]
    elif command == "COMPACT"
        before := index.pages.size()
        index = compact_tree(index)
        output = ["COMPACT nodes={before}->{index.pages.size()} height={height(index)}"]
    elif command == "SAVE"
        workbench.saved = index
        output = ["SAVE " + summary(index)]
    workbench.index = index
    return output

workbench := Workbench()
int command_count
scan(&command_count)
for: command_index < command_count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    match execute(&workbench, line)
        string[] output
            for row := output[]
                println(row)
        error problem
            println("ERROR " + problem.message)
